policy.name: Delhi Industrial Policy 2026 (approved by Delhi Cabinet, NOT yet notified); previous: Industrial Policy for Delhi 2010-2021

schemes.name: Delhi Industrial Policy 2026 - Technological modernisation incentive (Mukhyamantri Udyamshree Yojana) [pending notification]
schemes.clause: Not available - figures from press reports of the 14-10-2026 Cabinet decision
schemes.notes: NOT IN FORCE until notified. 25% of modernisation investment, cap Rs 5 crore (Rs 7 crore for women-led enterprises) per The Tribune 15-10-2026. Rs 1,000 crore earmarked for Mukhyamantri Udyamshree Yojana FY2026-27 to 2030-31 (window shown = that budget period, not a notified operative window). Further support for energy efficiency, rooftop solar and apprentice stipends - no figures reported. Eligibility/asset definitions unknown.

other_benefits: Draft Delhi Industrial Policy 2025-35 (released for comments mid-2025, per press/ICAI) proposed: 50% of FCI capital subsidy (cap Rs 50 crore, over 5 years) for frontier sectors, 6% interest subvention for 5 years, 100% SGST reimbursement for 5 years, patent cost up to Rs 5 lakh - DRAFT ONLY; final 2026 text may differ
Invest Delhi agency and Delhi Udyog Mitra portal to administer the 2026 policy (press)
unverifiable: No notified state industrial/MSME incentive policy in force for Delhi on 17-10-2026: the Industrial Policy for Delhi 2010-2021 has lapsed; the Delhi Industrial Policy 2026 (10-year) was approved by the Cabinet on 14-10-2026 (ANI 14-10-2026, Tribune 15-10-2026) but no gazette notification or official text was found.
industries.delhi.gov.in / delhi.gov.in unreachable from this environment; no official document read. Re-check for the notification and operational guidelines in the coming weeks.
Delhi has historically given no SGST reimbursement, electricity duty exemption or per-unit power subsidy to MSMEs; none confirmed in the 2026 policy.
